title: Driver scheduling system
summary: A scheduling system for bus operators, with a dispatch board that runs in the browser.

title: Paratransit scheduling app
summary: A trip scheduling app for paratransit service, built with Node.js, Express and SQLite.

title: Live vehicle positions feed
summary: A real-time feed of bus locations in GTFS Realtime, the standard format that trip-planning apps read.

title: Real-time bus stop display
summary: A prototype arrival display for bus stops, running on a CrowPanel ESP32-S3 board.

title: Procurement determination tool
summary: A step-by-step wizard that asks about a purchase and produces the price-reasonableness and small-purchase forms.

title: Bus coloring and story app
summary: A coloring and story app made for riders as community outreach.

title: LC Transit Simulator
summary: A 3D bus-driving game that runs in the browser, set on the real routes.

title: Sloth Rocket Grand Prix
summary: A 3D kart racer that runs in the browser. Five courses, five karts and split screen for up to four drivers, with Xbox controllers, a wheel and pedals, or the keyboard.
